relation_enforcement: Check exact source rows/texts and complete oracle states/flags, then the explicitly specified changed/invariant field lists and endpoint flags. Same IDs, differing labels, or matching counts alone cannot satisfy a relation. Reject an opaque-text/state replacement even if IDs/counts survive. Expected labels must not be generated from an extractor.
